$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.3.0-draft (pre-1.0). Shared scalar and small object types referenced by the resource schemas. Definitions only.
title: Common
description: Identifier, hash, timestamp and interval types shared by every resource schema.

opaque_id.description: The one identifier syntax of the contract: 1 to 128 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit, then letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. A uuid is a valid opaque_id, so voice-action targets can name any resource below. Identifiers are opaque and case-sensitive; valid syntax proves neither existence nor ownership.

uuid.description: Lowercase RFC 4122 text form, as the backend serialises uuid.UUID. Used where the backend row key is the identifier (uploads, investigations, jobs).

sha256.description: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, matching backend/services/api/schemas.py Sha256.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset, as Pydantic serialises an aware datetime (for example 2026-10-04T12:00:00Z). Seconds may carry up to six fractional digits.

interval.description: Half-open millisecond interval [start_ms, end_ms) on the named timebase. start_ms is at least 0 and strictly below end_ms; the validator checks the ordering on fixtures because JSON Schema cannot express it in this subset.

seq_range.description: Inclusive range of chunk sequence numbers that have not been received.
